announcements.title: Flood advisory — Purok 3 to 5
announcements.body: Water levels are rising near the creek. Residents in low-lying areas should prepare to evacuate if advised by officials.

announcements.title: Cloudy, 60% rain chance tomorrow
announcements.body: Expect scattered rain showers in the afternoon. Bring an umbrella if you're heading out.

announcements.title: Barangay Health Worker — 2 slots open
announcements.body: Looking for residents interested in community health work. Apply at the barangay hall before Friday.

announcements.title: Water interruption, July 28, 9am–3pm
announcements.body: Scheduled maintenance will interrupt water service in Puroks 1–4.

announcements.title: Basketball league finals this weekend
announcements.body: Finals start Saturday 3pm at the covered court. Everyone's welcome.

threads.title: Streetlight repair on Rizal St. — how's it holding up?
threads.author: Marites A.
threads.body: The new LED lights near the corner store have made a real difference at night. One post near the basketball court is still flickering though — worth a follow-up check.

comments.author: Kagawad Reyes
comments.body: Thanks for the heads-up — sending someone to check that post this week.

comments.author: Anonymous Resident
comments.body: Same here, noticed it flickering around 9pm most nights.

threads.title: Suggestion: covered court for the plaza
threads.author: Rico D.
threads.body: During the rainy season the plaza events keep getting cancelled. A simple roof structure over the existing court would let basketball league games and assemblies continue year-round.
threads.implementNote: Included in next quarter's infrastructure budget.

comments.author: Anonymous Resident
comments.body: This would be amazing, please make it happen!

threads.title: Q3 Satisfaction Survey — rate our barangay services
threads.author: Barangay Office
threads.body: Quick 4-question pulse on health center service, waste collection, road maintenance, and response time. Results are shared publicly once closed.

threads.title: Waste segregation bins — mixed results so far
threads.author: Leah S.
threads.body: The new color-coded bins are a good idea but pickup schedules haven't caught up — biodegradable bin overflowed twice this week before collection day.

threads.title: Add a night market once a month near the plaza
threads.author: Bimbo T.
threads.body: Could help small sari-sari and food vendors get more foot traffic, and give the community something to look forward to on weekends.

faqs.question: How do I share feedback or a suggestion with the barangay?
faqs.answer: Head to the Community Forum, choose Feedback or Suggestion, and post — it goes live once a barangay staff member approves it.

faqs.question: Can I file a complaint anonymously?
faqs.answer: Yes — toggle "submit anonymously" in the Complaint Center before sending your report.

faqs.question: How do I track my complaint's status?
faqs.answer: Every complaint gets a reference number you can check anytime under Complaint Center → Track Status.
